events.text: Greybank has lost contact with its relay. Your Phoenix Hawk and Trebuchet are the only machines available. The depot offers 4,000 credits to clear the approach.
Will you take the relay contract?
Take the south road to the relay. A Jenner is blocking the approach. Withdraw if necessary. Return here when the route is clear.
The relay is transmitting again. Your account has been credited with 4,000. Good work, commander.
The contract is complete. Explore the depot or end this mission.
Greybank is back on the network. Contract complete.
A Jenner guards the relay approach. Engage the raider?
The approach is secure. Return to the depot for your payment.
The raider holds the relay. Return to the depot and regroup.
You withdraw from the relay. The contract remains open.
The lance cannot deploy here. Return to the depot.
The depot offers machines and basic repairs.

objectives.title: Secure the relay
objectives.text: Clear the raider on the relay approach, then return to the depot for payment.
